closed_skeleton.reason: The carrier's exact constructor and rule signatures are not licensed; a Lean skeleton would itself choose an assertion calculus.

audited_sources.established_boundary: Formula is typed de Bruijn syntax; a description occurs only as Formula.descriptionScope and never as Term.
descriptionExists, descriptionScopePair and laterDescriptionOuterScope are reductional syntax definitions, not assertions.
PM.Derivation is indexed by Elementary only, so it cannot carry DescriptionSyntax.Formula.
OrderedAssertion is for the Star 9 Apparent syntax, not DescriptionSyntax.Formula.

minimal_carrier_contract.outer_shape: DescriptionDerivation (formula : Formula signature realContext apparentContext order) : Prop
minimal_carrier_contract.outer_shape_status: required-by-Q298-Q302-audits; identifier is descriptive, not a licensed Lean declaration name
nonnegotiable_invariants: The judgement is evidence of an object-language Formula, never Lean equality or a semantic truth predicate.
A description remains scoped Formula.descriptionScope; no Term.description constructor is permitted.
The real and apparent contexts remain explicit so weakening/substitution are capture-safe.
Assigned order remains an index; no global quantification over all PM types is permitted.
Derivation rules must be constructors or theorems proved from constructors, never axioms or opaque oracle constants.
minimal_carrier_contract.blocker: The printed dependency chains do not yet fix the carrier namespace, whether judgement is directly over Formula or a separately audited expansion bridge, nor the exact rule argument order.

must_preserve: typed equality under the candidate binder
expand only as an audited bridge, not as an assertion oracle

unblock_evidence_required: A source-audited declaration list fixes the carrier namespace, all indices, and every constructor argument order.
Each constructor has a printed-rule or previously kernel-checked provenance; no semantic completeness bridge is introduced.
A separate audit demonstrates that the carrier cannot encode a description as a term or collapse object propositions into Lean Prop.
Only after those signatures are fixed may a closed Lean skeleton be proposed and sent through the interface remapper.
